The seven-stage workflow -- each stage licenses less than the next
should change if it is used?
If the model does not reliably
A null is informative only if
Attribution ranks; intervention decides. Evidence never auto-promotes between levels. If a control fails the status is INSTRUMENT UNRESOLVED, not positive or negative.
The evidence ladder -- every column is a separate experiment
Does the model perform the computation?
The model exhibits a scoped behavior.
Probes, geometry, spectra, position or residual features
Information is decodable or structurally present.
Does a component read or select it before normalization?
A component scores the candidate relation.
The component routes attention using the signal.
OV analysis, output projection, downstream feature change
Does the component carry the causal effect?
The component mediates a measured fraction of the effect.
Do connected components implement the computation?
Edge/path interventions plus necessity and mediation
A scoped directed causal pathway implements the behavior.
Why does this mechanism exist and what does it mean biologically?
Training-data source tests, external assays, cross-model/species evidence
A biological origin or function is supported.
A study may enter the ladder at different observational levels, but it may not skip the causal bridge when making a causal claim.
show that a model component reads or routes the feature under an appropriate control
remove the feature or component and measure the declared behavior
restore or patch the candidate and recover the effect relative to matched nulls
isolate the path and rule out simpler or redundant alternatives
connect the mechanism to training-data provenance or biological function with an independently capable assay
The tool-to-question map -- and what each tool does NOT establish
Does the model perform the computation?
Native logits/losses, paired biological counterfactuals, baselines
Rescue, transplant, dose response, path patching
Matched nulls, protected channels, rival-path interventions
Sealed replication, checkpoint/model contrasts, external data
Rendered from docs/METHODOLOGY.md and docs/EVIDENCE_LADDER.md. No stage, level, tool or licensed statement is added here, and no component's status is asserted.
